description: Annualize and analyze a list of fees for anomalies. Use when needing to identify outliers and duplicates in fee structures. Avoid when needing to calculate annual costs only, use annual_cost instead.

fees.description: Fees to audit, each with name, amount, frequency and optional category

category.description: Optional benchmark category key, e.g. bank_overdraft

name: audit_fees

annualizedFees.description: A list of fees with their annualized amounts.

annualizedAmount.description: The annualized amount of the fee.

flags.description: A list of flags indicating issues with specific fees.

details.description: Additional details about the flagged issue.

issue.description: The type of issue flagged for the fee.

name.description: The name of the fee that triggered the flag.

monthlyAverage.description: The average monthly cost of all fees.

totalYearlyCost.description: The sum of all annualized fees.

title: Audit fees
